name: attach-shared
description: Point one component on many pages at one shared datasource, adding the component where it is missing.
when: The same content block must show on many pages from a single item (At a Glance on every article, Find Care on every location), or local copies of a block should be replaced by the shared item.

inputs.template: only pages of this template (name or id)
inputs.shared: { path } of the shared item, or { parent, name, templateId, fields } to create it (first run creates it; run again to attach)
inputs.after: catalog component key to insert after when the page does not have the component yet
inputs.replaceLocal: true (default): repoint existing local copies to the shared item

provenance.from: reference project: At a Glance on articles, Find Care local to shared
